name: Adobe Commerce
description: Adobe Commerce (formerly Magento Commerce) is Adobe's enterprise ecommerce platform for B2B and B2C businesses, combining open-source extensibility with native tools for content, merchandising, and multi-site management.
best_for: Enterprise B2B and B2C brands that need deep customization, multi-site/multi-region storefronts, and complex catalog or pricing rules beyond what off-the-shelf platforms offer.
features: Page Builder drag-and-drop content editor for building storefront pages without coding
B2B functionality including company accounts, purchasing permissions, and purchase orders
Requisition lists for saving and reordering frequently purchased products
Multisite architecture for running region-specific storefronts with shared catalog and marketing resources
Native localization supporting multiple languages, currencies, and tax regulations
AI-driven product recommendations and personalized search and merchandising
Dynamic customer segmentation based on behavior, demographics, and purchase history
Real-time inventory and order management tools

alternatives.name: Shopify
alternatives.description: A hosted commerce platform for building and managing online stores across web, mobile, and in-person sales.
alternatives.best_for: Merchants who want a fully managed platform without hosting or infrastructure overhead.

alternatives.name: BigCommerce
alternatives.description: A SaaS ecommerce platform for building and scaling online stores with built-in enterprise features.
alternatives.best_for: Growing and mid-market retailers wanting built-in enterprise features without added transaction fees.

alternatives.name: Shopware
alternatives.description: An open-source ecommerce platform combining B2B capabilities, modular architecture, and AI-powered tools.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprise brands wanting open-source flexibility with strong B2B support.
